xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DeclarationOfUnmodifiedOpinion: Statement on impact of audit qualification
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: 1. Inventory: The Company carries inventories aggregating Rs. 2,836.48 lakh as at September 30, 2026 reflecting a substantial reduction as compared to Rs. 4,333.79 lakh as at March 31, 2026. We have not been provided with basis, methodology or documented physical verification records, condition assessment or valuation records or reconciliations of book inventory with periodic stock statements submitted to the Company's bankers supporting the quantity, condition and valuation of these inventories as at September 30, 2026. This matter was also the subject of a qualification by the predecessor auditor in their report on the audited Consolidated financial results for the year ended March 31, 2026. In the absence of sufficient appropriate evidence, we are unable to assess the compliance of the inventory valuation with the requirements of Ind AS 2 (Inventories) and determine whether any adjustments are required to the carrying value of inventories as at September 30, 2026, and the consequential impact thereof on cost of materials consumed changes in inventories, loss for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, and other equity as at that date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonsIfManagementIsUnableToE: The Management has noted the observation. The inventory has been valued in accordance with the applicable accounting standards and the Companys accounting policies. The Management is compiling the physical verification condition assessment and valuation supporting documents and shall provide the same to the Auditors. Based on the Managements assessment no material adjustment is presently considered necessary.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditorsCommentsOnManagementsE: 1 The Management's response is noted. However, as on the date of this review, sufficient appropriate audit evidence, including physical verification records, inventory valuation workings, condition assessment has not been provided to us. Accordingly, we are unable to independently verify the quantity, conditions of materials and valuation of inventories as at September 30, 2026, since it is technical in nature we are unable quantify the exact amount of loss, however management has estimated the loss while valuing the inventory by 374.47 Lakhs . The Management's representation that no material adjustment is presently considered necessary does not constitute sufficient audit evidence. Therefore, the qualification remains unresolved, and the consequential impact, if any, on the financial results cannot be ascertained.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: 2. Advance to Laxmi Spintex Private Limited: The Company's books reflect a continuing balance of approximately Rs. 731.40 lakh as at September 30, 2026 due from its wholly owned subsidiary, Laxmi Spintex Private Limited. We have not been provided with evidence of the Board/committee approvals and compliance with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 (including Sections 185, 186 and 188, as applicable) in relation to this balance, nor with evidence regarding its precise nature, terms and recoverability. Consequently, we are unable to determine whether any adjustment or additional disclosure is required in this regard.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonsIfManagementIsUnableToE: The Management has noted the observation. The amount represents an intra group balance with the wholly owned subsidiary and has been appropriately eliminated while preparing the Consolidated Financial Statements. The Management is reconciling the respective ledgers and compiling the relevant consolidation workings, approvals and supporting documents. Necessary adjustmentdisclosure if any shall be made upon completion of the review.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditorsCommentsOnManagementsE: 2 The Management's response is noted. However, the elimination of the intra-group balance in the Consolidated Financial Statements does not address the matters relating to the recognition, nature, terms and recoverability of the advance in the Standalone Financial Statements. Further, the requisite Board/Committee approvals and supporting documents evidencing compliance with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, have not been made available to us. In the absence of sufficient appropriate audit evidence, we are unable to comment on the appropriateness of the balance and the consequential impact, if any, on the Standalone Financial Statements. Accordingly, the qualification remains unresolved. There is no impact on profit and loss account of the company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: 3. Advance to a creditor: Other current assets as at September 30, 2026 include advances to suppliers and service providers aggregating Rs. 1,139.90 lakh (Rs. 1,125.96 lakh as at March 31, 2026), which the Company has represented includes a significant advance to a creditor in respect of which indicators of financial stress at the counterparty and uncertainty over recoverability and end-use were reported by the predecessor auditor. We have not been provided with a party-wise ageing and recoverability assessment identifying this advance separately, nor with an evaluation of expected credit loss thereon under Ind AS 109. Consequently, we are unable to determine whether any adjustment to this balance and to the results for the quarter is necessary.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonsIfManagementIsUnableToE: The Management has noted the observation and is undertaking a party wise reconciliation ageing and recoverability assessment of advances to suppliers and service providers. The relevant supporting documents and assessment shall be provided to the Auditors. The Management shall recognise any impairmentadjustment if required based on the outcome of the assessment.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditorsCommentsOnManagementsE: 3 The Management's response is noted. However assessment of recoverability, including evaluation of expected credit loss in accordance with Ind AS 109, have not been provided to us for verification. In the absence of such supporting evidence, we are unable to assess the recoverability of the advances and determine whether any impairment provision or adjustment is required. Accordingly, the qualification remains unresolved, and the consequential impact, if any, on the financial results cannot be ascertained, since management is taking appropriate steps to recover the advance paid to suppliers.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: 4. Land transferred to subsidiary: During the financial year 2024-25, the Company reduced the gross carrying value of freehold land by Rs. 217.55 lakh, consequent to a stated sale to its wholly owned subsidiary, Laxmi Spintex Private Limited, at fair value. As at September 30, 2026, the legal formalities for registration of the sale deed remain incomplete, no reversal of the transaction has been recorded, and we have not been provided with sufficient appropriate evidence to conclude whether the significant risks and rewards, and legal title, of ownership have been transferred. Consequently, we are unable to determine whether the continued exclusion of Rs. 217.55 lakh from Property, Plant and Equipment is appropriate as at September 30, 2026.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonsIfManagementIsUnableToE: The Management has noted the observation. The land transferred to the wholly owned subsidiary continues to form part of the Groups assets. The Management is compiling the subsidiary wise fixed asset details consolidation workings and documents relating to the land transfer and registration. Any adjustment or disclosure if required shall be made upon completion of the review.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditorsCommentsOnManagementsE: 4 The Management's response is noted. However, the fact that the land continues to form part of the Group's assets does not, by itself, establish the appropriateness of its derecognition in the Standalone Financial Statements. The requisite legal documentation, registered sale deed and other supporting evidence establishing the transfer of ownership and significant risks and rewards have not been provided to us. In the absence of sufficient appropriate audit evidence, we are unable to conclude whether the derecognition of land from Property, Plant and Equipment is appropriate as at September 30, 2026. Accordingly, the qualification remains unresolved. The management is hopeful to receive the approval from the revenue authority in short period.
